info.name: Bamboo Account Management One Step Registration API

items.docs: This endpoint combines all the registration steps into a single API endpoint. To use this endpoint, you have to provide all fields in the defined payload, and also ensure that the user’s ID has been verified. Please note that you are required to subscribe to at least one market on user's first account activation. A dictionary endpoint is provided below to give insight into all the questions and acceptable values for the fields within the payload.
